body: [b]THE THREE STATS[/b]
[color=#00ff00]Ambition[/color]: Scope of features you ship.
-> More features = higher review scores (but requires stability)
-> Each card costs runway days
[color=#ffff00]Instability[/color]: How janky your game is.
-> Interactions between features add instability
-> High instability = beloved jank, especially with soul backing it up
-> Can be reduced by fixing bugs (costs 1 day and 3 Soul)
[color=#ff7fff]Soul[/color]: Your creative integrity.
-> Dev logs boost it slowly (costs 1 day, +1 Soul)
-> Fixing bugs drains it hard (-3 Soul)
-> Defining Game requires Soul >= 8 at ship
[b]WINNING[/b]
Ending priority at ship:
* [color=#ff00ff]Defining Game[/color]: Ambition >= 25, Instability 15-40, Soul >= 8.
* [color=#ff5555]Cult Disaster[/color]: Instability > 40 and Soul < 5.
* [color=#cccccc]Rough Diamond[/color]: Ambition < 15, Instability < 15, Soul >= 8.
* Then bucket endings: Legendary Jank, Cult Classic, Surprise Hit, Prestige Collapse, Financial Catastrophe.
Secret no longer uses cross-run soul totals; it resolves directly from your ship-time Goldilocks stats.
[b]STRATEGY TIPS[/b]
* Runway Days: You have 21 days. Plan accordingly.
* Interactions: Cards with overlapping tags create them (see event feed).
* Replayability: Different card combos unlock different story beats.
* The game gets harder: Later cards have more instability impact.
